verdict.rationale: Devin is itself an AI agent, and the docs describe delegating tickets, features, bug fixes and migrations to it through a conversational UI with an embedded IDE you can take over. Delegation also works from Slack/Teams threads, via Ask Devin for scoping, and by running parallel tasks or cloud handoffs that continue after you close your laptop. Hands-on community reports confirm users delegate real work, though with reliability caveats. Missing for 10: independent evidence of dependable task completion, since hands-on users report extraneous changes and sessions that loop without asking for help.
